description:
Title: Storage management

First, the order is read from the automatic order management system.
Then, it's checked if the first product from the order is in stock.
If it's in stock then it's withdrawn from the warehouse.
However, if it's not in stock then it's reordered from the wholesaler.
Note, that if it was necessary to wait more then 10 days for the arrival of the  product then a delivery delay penalty is automatically demanded from the wholesaler.
After the ordered product has arrived it's registered in the stock management system.
Finally, it's checked if the whole order is ready for shipment.
If the order is ready for shipment, a courier is requested and the products are packed simultaneously and finally shipped.
If it isn't then the next product from the order is selected and the process starts again with checking if this order is in stock or not.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_StorageManagement"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/storage-management">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Reorder" name="Product reorder"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProductArrival" name="Product arrival"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DelayPenalty" name="Delivery delay penalty demand"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CourierRequest" name="Courier request"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_StorageManagement">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" processRef="Process_StorageManagement"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Wholesaler" name="Wholesaler"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Courier" name="Courier"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Reorder" name="Reorder product" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler" messageRef="Message_Reorder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProductArrivalDirect" name="Product arrival" sourceRef="Participant_Wholesaler" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProductArrivalDirect" messageRef="Message_ProductArrival"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProductArrivalAfterPenalty" name="Product arrival" sourceRef="Participant_Wholesaler" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProductArrivalAfterPenalty" messageRef="Message_ProductArrival"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayPenalty" name="Delivery delay penalty demand" sourceRef="Task_DemandDelayPenalty" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler" messageRef="Message_DelayPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CourierRequest" name="Courier request" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Participant_Courier" messageRef="Message_CourierRequest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderProcessing" name="Order processing starts"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ReadOrder" name="Read order from automatic order management system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check if first product is in stock"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockDecision" name="Is the first product in stock?" default="Flow_NotInStock"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WithdrawProduct" name="Withdraw product from warehouse"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderProduct" name="Reorder product from wholesaler" messageRef="Message_Reorder"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_ArrivalOrDelay" name="Wait for product arrival or 10 days"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DelayTimer" name="10 days pass without arrival">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_Delay">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">PT240H</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProductArrivalDirect" name="Receive product arrival" messageRef="Message_ProductArrival"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DemandDelayPenalty" name="Automatically demand delivery delay penalty" messageRef="Message_DelayPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProductArrivalAfterPenalty" name="Wait for product arrival" messageRef="Message_ProductArrival"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RegisterProduct" name="Register product in stock management system"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderReadyDecision" name="Is the whole order ready for shipment?" default="Flow_OrderNotReady"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShipmentSplit" name="Request courier and pack products"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestCourier" name="Request courier" messageRef="Message_CourierRequest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackProducts" name="Pack products"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShipmentJoin" name="Courier requested and products packed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShipProducts" name="Ship products"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectNextProduct" name="Select next product"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Shipped" name="Order shipped"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ReadOrder" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderProcessing" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadOrder_CheckStock" sourceRef="Task_ReadOrder" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckStock_StockDecision" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_StockDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InStock" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_StockDecision" targetRef="Task_WithdrawProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The first product is in stock</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInStock" name="Not in stock" sourceRef="Gateway_StockDecision" targetRef="Task_ReorderProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Withdraw_CheckReady" sourceRef="Task_WithdrawProduct" targetRef="Gateway_OrderReadyDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reorder_Wait" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Gateway_ArrivalOrDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Timer" sourceRef="Gateway_ArrivalOrDelay" targetRef="Event_DelayTimer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_ArrivalDirect" sourceRef="Gateway_ArrivalOrDelay" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProductArrivalDirect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Timer_Penalty" sourceRef="Event_DelayTimer" targetRef="Task_DemandDelayPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Penalty_WaitArrival" sourceRef="Task_DemandDelayPenalty" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProductArrivalAfterPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArrivalDirect_Register" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProductArrivalDirect" targetRef="Task_RegisterProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArrivalAfterPenalty_Register" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProductArrivalAfterPenalty" targetRef="Task_RegisterProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_CheckReady" sourceRef="Task_RegisterProduct" targetRef="Gateway_OrderReadyDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderReady" name="Ready for shipment" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReadyDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The whole order is ready for shipment</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderNotReady" name="Not ready for shipment" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReadyDecision" targetRef="Task_SelectNextProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectNext_CheckStock" sourceRef="Task_SelectNextProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_RequestCourier" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentSplit" targetRef="Task_RequestCourier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_PackProducts" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentSplit" targetRef="Task_PackProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestCourier_Join" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackProducts_Join" sourceRef="Task_PackProducts" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_ShipProducts" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin" targetRef="Task_ShipProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShipProducts_End" sourceRef="Task_ShipProducts" targetRef="EndEvent_Shipped"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
